title: WSS draft end-to-end overdetermination sweep
description:
Read draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md with the overdetermination lens. Earlier targeted spot-checks found no findings in WSS (ping/pong cadence is correctly inherited from RFC 8887/6455; suppression rules at line 214 are appropriate). But a full end-to-end pass has not been done.

Things worth specifically looking at:
- Reconnect timing / backoff
- Message ordering on disconnect (does the spec take a position?)
- WebSocket frame-level constraints
- ChatStreamEnable / ChatStreamDisable semantics
- ChatTypingEvent / ChatPresenceEvent delivery rules (lines 198, 214, 220, 374, 384)
- Owner-vs-other delivery isolation (line 384)

Method matches the federation-MUSTs sweep: file findings, close with summary, 'no findings' is acceptable.
acceptance_criteria:
- WSS draft read end-to-end
- Findings filed as new beads (or 'no findings' stated explicitly)
- Close-reason summarizes outcome
